02 / ABOUT ME

Hello!

</>

I’m Thilanga Dilshan, a third-year undergraduate at SLTC Research University, pursuing a career as a Security Operations Center (SOC) analyst.

My current learning focuses on security monitoring and SIEM, network traffic analysis, and incident handling and logging. I also enjoy building websites and applying secure development practices.

Always learning. Always asking why.

What drives me.

  • 01

    Understand the system

    Look beneath the surface to learn how networks, code, and people connect.

  • 02

    Build with security in mind

    Bring a security-first mindset to the websites and apps I create.

  • 03

    Learn by doing

    Explore in safe lab environments, document discoveries, and keep improving.
